title: Introduce veracity score and autodraft release composer
author: Aisha Rahman
release_notes: Adds a model veracity scoring signal to onboarding and an automated release-note composer that drafts concise changelogs from profile deltas and telemetry. No public API changes; backward-compatible metadata fields added.
description:
Context and motivation: As model onboarding volume grows and teams rely on automated release notes for stability reviews, we need a deterministic, reviewable signal that captures model 'veracity' (how consistent outputs are vs. ground probes and production telemetry) and a lightweight composer that drafts release notes from profile deltas, sample regressions, and curated human annotations. This PR introduces a veracity_score field in the model profile, a scoring pipeline with configurable probes, and an autodraft release composer that synthesizes human-readable release notes for reviewers to iterate on.

What changed (high-level): 1) Veracity scorer: new evaluator module that runs a battery of semantic probes (consistency checks, hallucination heuristics, calibration tests) and normalizes into a 0-100 veracity_score with per-subsignal breakdowns saved as tags. 2) Autodraft release composer: a rules-and-templates engine that consumes profile deltas, telemetry highlights, and veracity regressions to generate an initial release note draft and bulletized impact statements. 3) Onboard workflow updates: profile schema bump (added optional fields), onboarding CLI flag (--with-veracity), and CI hooks to surface veracity deltas to devs. 4) Observability: added three metrics (veracity_distribution, autodraft_quality_score, composer_latency) and a dashboard snippet.

Detailed technical summary: - scorer/engine.py: new scoring harness that executes probe sets in parallel, aggregates weighted scores, and emits a provenance envelope. Probes are pluggable; initial set includes: semantic_coherence_probe, repetition_entropy_probe, calibration_brier_probe, reference_overlap_probe. - composer/draft.py: template-driven hydrator that maps delta tags (e.g., latency_up, tokens_increase, veracity_drop_5pct) to prioritized impact bullets using a small rule-table and a short natural-language surface formatter. - migrations/20251107_profile_schema_v2.sql: schema migration adds veracity_score (FLOAT), veracity_tags (JSONB), and release_draft (TEXT) to model_profile table; fields are optional to remain backward-compatible. - cli/onboard.py: added --with-veracity boolean flag (defaults to false for quick onboard) that triggers a lightweight probe pass and enqueues a background detailed scoring job. - tests/: added unit tests for score normalization, composer templating, and an integration test that runs an end-to-end onboard -> draft flow against a synthetic model bundle.

Commits (summary): - 1a2b3c4: introduce veracity scorer harness and baseline probes - 2b3c4d5: add composer engine and rule-table templates - 3c4d5e6: migration and DB wiring for optional profile fields - 4d5e6f7: CLI flag and background job wiring - 5e6f7g8: metrics and dashboard snippet - 6f7g8h9: tests and docs additions

Files changed (high level): - scorer/engine.py, scorer/probes/*.py - composer/draft.py, composer/templates/*.yaml - migrations/20251107_profile_schema_v2.sql - cli/onboard.py - docs/onboarding/veracity.md - observability/dashboards/veracity.json - tests/test_veracity_normalization.py, tests/test_composer_endtoend.py

Review conversation (highlights): - Priya Desai (reviewer): "Please include a short section in docs about probe selection and expected false positive modes. Also request that the composer explicitly mark autodrafts so reviewers don't mistake them for human-crafted notes." — Aisha: "Updated docs/onboarding/veracity.md with probe descriptions and added a top-line disclaimer in composer output: 'AUTODRAFT — please review'." - Liam O'Neill: "Can we make the DB migration additive and no-op if the columns already exist? We need safe rollbacks for Private installs." — Aisha: "Migration uses IF NOT EXISTS semantics and a reversible down script; added a smoke rollback test in CI." - Connor Blake: "I'd like the scoring weights to be configurable per-repo/team. Do we have a plan?" — Aisha: "Yes; composer and scorer read a repository-level config file (profile_config.yml). Default weights are committed; per-repo overrides live in /configs/ overrides and are validated by the schema validator." - Priya (follow-up): "Minor nit: add a small E2E with a real-ish telemetry sample to ensure autodrafts don't exceed 2s latency." — Aisha: "Added an integration test asserting composer_latency < 2.0s for the synthetic sample. CI reproduces this in 2.3s on first run, optimized to 1.1s after caching template load."

CI and checks: - unit tests: pass - integration tests: pass (composer latency assertion included) - linting: pass (flake8/black checks) - schema validator: pass - e2e on staging: pass

Backward compatibility and migration notes: - Profile schema change is additive and optional; existing onboarded models will not have veracity fields until rescored. - Onboard CLI defaults to existing behaviour unless --with-veracity is used; this keeps light-weight quick onboarding unchanged. - The autodraft composer stores generated drafts in release_draft column but does not publish anything automatically; human approval step required.

Security and privacy considerations: - All probe runs avoid sending user PII to remote services; probes run in-process or on customer VPC when using Private deployments. - Composer templates do not include raw model examples or sample outputs unless the operator explicitly enables sample_in_draft in profile_config.yml.

Performance notes: - Initial scorer run for a mid-sized model (7B) completes in ~6s on our standard probe runner; incremental re-scores with cached embeddings are ~1.1s. - Composer average latency measured at 0.8s after template cache warmup. Metrics emitted to give teams SLO visibility.

Follow-up work (future PRs): - richer probe set with model-usage-aware thresholds (ENG-2101) - per-team weight tuning UI in Console (PM-162) - integrate composer feedback loop that learns preferred phrasing over time (ENG-2189)

Merge outcome: Squash and merge performed by Priya Desai after thumbs-up from all reviewers. Release pipeline created a draft internal note and surfaced a pending migration that ops scheduled for next maintenance window.

Notes for on-call and ops: Migration script included in artifacts; ops should run migration with downtime window for Private installs where DB locks are constrained. CI tag: veracity-release-20251114.
notes: Ops: run migrations with downtime window for large Private clusters; composer is opt-in by default.
comment_summary: All reviewers approved after small doc and migration nit fixes; CI passed; merged by Priya.
